analysis.reasonEn: RSI at 39.7, entering oversold territory, down from 53.7 five days ago. ADX at 20.5, early stage of trend formation. MACD histogram worsening to -1.2832. Volume ratio at 0.59, indicating contraction. While the current price of $89.54 shows a recovery signal from the 20-day low of $87.05, it's declining from the 5-day high of $95.60, indicating a lack of direction. The 52-week position at 73.2% is in a pullback phase from the high. Weekly RSI is neutral at 51.6, and weekly MACD histogram is at -0.7763, showing weakness. Weekly ADX at 12.1 indicates no trend. Overall, a lack of directional conviction warrants a wait-and-see approach.

analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($89.54) vs SMA5 ($90.39)/SMA20 ($95.58)/SMA50 ($92.51): below short-term, below mid-term, below mid-term; diagnosing weakening mid-to-long-term trend.
· Position relative to SMA100 ($91.77)/SMA200 ($82.59): diagnosing weak mid-to-long-term trend.
· 52-week position (73.2%) + current price range is a pullback phase from historical highs.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (53.7→39.7): entering oversold, confirming downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.1613→-1.2832): continued weakness, no trend reversal signal confirmed.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $88.61): approaching lower band, reduced volatility.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($88.30): expecting support based on Pivot S1 ($83.85) and 20-day low ($87.05).
· Swing resistance ($92.14): confirmed resistance based on Pivot PP ($92.74) and SMA5 ($90.39).
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern: range-bound phase, diagnosing lack of direction.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.59x): decreased reliability of price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): conditions for waiting are met, deferring buy/sell entry.
